audit.why: 53.61% over 679 games with an EVEN label and a level chart that gives Malphite Levels 2-3, First item and 2+ items matches the kits: neither tank can kill the other early, and Ground Slam's armour scaling means every item widens Malphite's edge while Sejuani's damage stays flat.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes cite no cooldowns, and the first-item spike is justified by 'her percent-HP W barely scratches a tank' — a property Winter's Wrath does not have.
audit.why: Riot's Winter's Wrath text is 'swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks' — no max-health component anywhere, and the kit file carries no percentHealth flag on it. The real first-item logic is that Ground Slam 'deals magic damage based on his Armor'.
audit.corrected: Your first armour item scales Ground Slam directly, so defence doubles as damage; her damage is flat and does not follow.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer is built on 'track Permafrost's cooldown' and 'engage once it is down'. Permafrost is a 1.5-second cooldown — it is never down. The page also says Frost stacks come from her autos and calls Permafrost a passive.
audit.why: Riot text, Permafrost: 'Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks' at 1.5s. Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s) is the ability that applies Frost stacks. So the gating cooldown a Malphite must actually watch is her W, not her E. Also Fury of the North grants Armor, Magic Resist and immunity to slows out of combat, which blunts the opening Seismic Shard specifically.
audit.corrected: Permafrost is a 1.5s trigger that fires the instant Frost maxes; Winter's Wrath on 9s at rank 1 is the real gate. Break off before the second W lands. And she is slow-immune out of combat under Frost Armor, so damage her before you rely on Q to kite.

edits.before: Two slow tanks staring at each other — neither of you kills the other at Levels 1-3, so this is a farm lane until your buttons come online. Her real threat is the Permafrost passive: a couple of autos and her E stuns you, which is a free jungle dive if you over-extend. Don't walk into auto range to throw a greedy Q; last-hit at range, keep Granite Shield up, and never give her the E-stun window with her jungler nearby.
edits.after: Two slow tanks staring at each other — neither of you kills the other at Levels 1-3, so this is a farm lane until your buttons come online. Her real threat is the stun chain: Winter's Wrath (W) applies Frost stacks and Permafrost (E) stuns the instant they max, on a 1.5-second cooldown. Last-hit at the 625 tip of Seismic Shard, keep Granite Shield up, and never stand for a second W with her jungler unaccounted for.

edits.before: This is where you take the lane over. At 4-5 your W (Thunderclap) gives you armor and AoE empowered autos while your E attack-speed slow blunts her trades, and Granite Shield lets you farm through anything she does. Her W only does percent-max-HP — annoying but it never threatens a kill on a tank. At 6 your Unstoppable Force is the swing button: you initiate ganks and 2v2s on your terms, while her R is purely a reactive peel/counter-engage. Force fights when your R is up and hers is down.
edits.after: This is where you take the lane over. At 4-5 Thunderclap and Ground Slam's attack-speed slow blunt her trades, and Granite Shield lets you farm through anything she does. Her stun chain is the entire threat: Winter's Wrath (9s at rank 1) applies the Frost stacks and Permafrost is a 1.5-second button that fires the moment they max, so break off before the second W. At 6, Unstoppable Force initiates on your terms while Glacial Prison (120s) can only answer.

edits.before: You out-scale her as a frontline because every armor item makes your E and Thunderclap splash hit harder, while her flat tank damage flatlines into your stacked armor. Her W percent-HP and her CC chain still matter in teamfights, so respect her R (Glacial Prison) layering onto your engage — don't flank into a fight where she can counter-CC your dive. But in the straight 1v1 and the sidelane, your Q slow plus armor-scaled damage owns her all game.
edits.after: You out-scale her as a frontline because Ground Slam's damage is based on your armour, so every armour item buys defence and damage at once while her damage stays flat. Her CC chain still matters in fights: Glacial Prison is 1300 range on 120 seconds and layers straight onto your engage, so don't flank into it alone. In the sidelane, Seismic Shard's move-speed steal plus armour-scaled damage owns her all game.

notes: Most useful finding: the entire full layer coaches 'track Permafrost' and 'engage once Permafrost is down', but Permafrost's cooldown is 1.5 seconds — it is never down. The gating ability is Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s), which is what applies the Frost stacks Permafrost consumes. I could not fix full focus.text, which still reads 'Sejuani Permafrost' (18 chars); 'Sejuani Winter's Wrath' is 22 and would be rejected by the length band, so that field needs a manual change — it currently points the player at the wrong ability on the loading screen. Second correction: the page claims Winter's Wrath is percent-max-health damage in three places. Riot's text has no max-health component and the kit file carries no percentHealth flag on it. Also verified but not asserted anywhere: Malphite's kit file flags Seismic Shard and Ground Slam as 'grounding', which Riot's descriptions do not support, so Sejuani's Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1) is NOT something the page should claim you can deny.
